HIMANSHU SHARMA Financial Planning & Analysis | Corporate Accounting CA Inter │ Big 4 (PwC & Deloitte) │ FP&A │ Power BI │ Alteryx

📞 7004167034 ✉ himanshusharmaranchi14@gmail.com 📍 Bengaluru, Karnataka

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY Results-driven finance professional with 7+ years of progressive experience spanning real estate private equity fund accounting, FP&A, and Big 4 audit (PwC & Deloitte). Currently working as a Real Estate Private Equity Fund Accountant at Pretium Enterprise Operations (US shift), specialising in Yardi-based fund accounting, investor reporting, and GL management across private equity real estate fund structures. Big 4 background includes private equity audit at Deloitte (fund NAV, LP capital accounts, fair value, waterfall reviews) and AWM/Insurance/Banking audit at PwC — providing a strong command of fund financial statements, valuation frameworks, and investor reporting standards. Worked for Clients like CIBC, RBC, JP Morgan. Goldman Sachs, Franklin Templeton, Blackstone, KKR. Proven track record of building automated Power BI and Excel dashboards that reduced reporting delivery time by 35%, and leading annual planning cycles and scenario modelling that directly informed senior leadership decisions. Proficient in Yardi, Oracle ERP, Alteryx, US GAAP, Ind AS (IFRS), IGAAP, and advanced Excel.

CORE COMPETENCIES

▸ Budgeting & Forecasting

▸ Power BI Dashboards

▸ Internal Controls & Audit

▸ Variance & Trend Analysis

▸ Scenario & ROI Analysis

▸ Demand & Utilisation Planning

▸ Financial Modelling

▸ Month-End Close & Accruals

▸ Ind AS / IFRS / IGAAP / US GAAP

WORK EXPERIENCE

Pretium Enterprise Operations (PEO) | Bangalore Real Estate Private Equity Fund Accountant — US Shift Fund accounting, investor reporting, and GL management for private equity real estate funds (US GAAP); Yardi specialist:

2026 – Present

Execute fund-level month-end close in Yardi, including preparation of journal entries, account reconciliations, and review of Balance Sheet, P&L, and Trial Balance across multiple private equity real estate fund entities and their underlying property holdings.

Manage intercompany eliminations, fund-level wire transactions, and treasury entries within Yardi; oversee cash positions, investor distributions, capital calls, and escrow administration across fund vehicles.

Perform bank reconciliations and maintain fixed asset registers in Yardi, covering capitalization, depreciation, and impairment reviews across real estate assets and fund-held properties.

Conduct variance analysis (actual vs. budget/prior period) at fund and property level; deliver clear investor-ready narratives to senior management and US stakeholders under tight US-shift close timelines.

Maintain Yardi-based accounting processes, SOPs, and internal controls to ensure fund audit readiness and compliance with US GAAP, SEC reporting requirements, and corporate policies.

Collaborate with US Pretium fund managers, portfolio management teams, internal audit, and business unit personnel to address queries, support investor reporting, and drive Yardi system enhancements and process automation initiatives.

Deloitte | Bangalore Assurance Associate — Private Equity Audit Audit engagement for US-based private equity fund clients; focus on fund financial statements, investment valuations, and LP reporting integrity:

2026 (prior to PEO)

– Performed substantive testing on investment portfolios (equity, debt, and real asset holdings), fair value

measurements under ASC 820, and income recognition — building deep understanding of PE fund structures, valuation methodologies, and return attribution across fund strategies.

Worked for Clients - Blackstone, KKR. – Tested fund NAV computations, waterfall calculations, carried interest accruals, and management fee allocations; identified variance drivers and reported control gaps to senior audit leadership.

Audited LP capital accounts, capital call and distribution notices, and investor reporting packages; reviewed fund agreement terms to verify compliance with economic allocations and LP waterfall provisions.

Supported SOX 404 testing and ISAE 3402 / SSAE 18 control reviews, documenting design and operating effectiveness across key fund financial reporting processes — developing strong command of PE fund governance, internal control frameworks, and regulatory compliance.

Reviewed fund financial statements and footnote disclosures for compliance with US GAAP, coordinating with engagement teams to resolve accounting treatment, classification, and presentation issues ahead of reporting deadlines.

Performed walkthroughs of accounting processes and internal controls for PE fund clients, documenting process narratives and control matrices used in audit risk assessment and planning.

PwC | Bangalore Audit Associate — Asset & Wealth Management / Insurance / Banking

2024 – 2025

Executed statutory audits for AWM, Insurance, and Banking clients; performed detailed testing on financial statements, NAV computations, and valuation models.

Worked for Clients - JP Morgan, Goldman Sachs, Franklin Templeton, RBC, CIBC – Prepared PBC schedules, reconciliations, and walkthroughs — developing structured skills in financial data management, management accounts preparation, and reporting package delivery.

Coordinated with cross-border and cross-functional teams to ensure timely sign-offs, building experience with tight reporting deadlines, multi-stakeholder communication, and financial close cycles.

Documented audit work in line with PwC GAM (Aura), demonstrating structured approach to financial data and reporting governance.

Reviewed investment valuations and disclosures for AWM clients under US GAAP and Ind AS, verifying appropriate application of fair value hierarchies and valuation inputs.

Assisted in planning and risk assessment procedures, including scoping of significant accounts and identification of key audit risks across engagements.

Nightingale Services | India Record to Report (R2R) Associate Record to Report role with end-to-end ownership of month-end close, GL accounting, reconciliations, and financial reporting across multiple business units:

2022 – 2024

Owned month-end and quarter-end close for multiple business units — journal entries, GL account reconciliations, and closing schedules — supported by automated Excel/Power BI dashboards that cut reporting delivery time by 35%.

Prepared and reviewed balance sheet reconciliations, accrual schedules, and GL flux/variance analysis, ensuring accuracy and audit-readiness of the general ledger.

Processed accruals, prepaid amortisation, and adjusting journal entries; validated account balances and closed GL line items in line with month-end close checklists.

Maintained fixed asset registers and reconciled billing/revenue entries against GL postings, resolving mismatches under tight close deadlines.

R. Kaushal & Associates | India Article Assistant

2019 – 2022

Conducted statutory audits, GST audits, and income tax audits across diverse industries; assisted in financial statement drafting, tax computations, and compliance filings.

Supported field audit work including documentation, data extraction, and reconciliations — developing foundational skills in financial data analysis.

R. Kothari & Co. | India Article Assistant

2018 – 2019

Carried out statutory, Income Tax, and GST audits for clients in Steel Manufacturing, Food Processing, E- Services, Heavy Machinery Trading, and Real Estate sectors.

TOOLS & TECHNOLOGY

Reporting & BI

Power BI │ Excel (Advanced: Pivot Tables, Power Query, Macros, Dashboards) │ Alteryx

ERP & Systems

Oracle ERP │ Yardi (real estate GL & property accounting) │ MRI │ Slack │ PwC Aura (GAM)

Accounting Standards

Ind AS (IFRS) │ IGAAP │ US GAAP (ASC 606, SOX 404) │ CAS

Finance Skills

Budgeting │ Forecasting │ Scenario Modelling │ Variance Analysis │ Financial Modelling │ ROI Analysis │ GL & Sub-ledger Accounting │ Bank Reconciliations │ Fixed Assets

EDUCATION CA Inter — Institute of Chartered Accountants of India B.Com (Honours – Finance and Accounts) — Ranchi University

2015 – 2019 2015 – 2018

CERTIFICATIONS & COURSES

▸ Financial Modelling — EY (Ernst & Young)

▸ Reading Financial Statements — CFI

▸ Alteryx Core Micro-Credential

▸ Math Fundamentals for Capital Markets — CFI

▸ Economics for Capital Markets — CFI

▸ Excel Crash Course — CFI

▸ Fundamentals of Credit — CFI

▸ Prompt Engineering — LinkedIn Learning
